item.title: Facebook Graph API: Fetching Specific User Data in JavaScript
item.description:
“Facebook Graph API: Fetching Specific User Data in JavaScript”

When interacting with the Facebook Graph API using JavaScript, particularly after version 2.4, you need to explicitly define the fields you wish to retrieve. This requirement aims to enhance performance, especially on mobile networks. Previously, requests like /me/feed would return a broad set of data by default; however, this behavior changed, necessitating a more targeted approach to data fetching.

How can we effectively request specific user profile information, such as id, name, and gender, using the Facebook JavaScript SDK?
